title: migrate-dbs
summary: Moves project index databases into each project's own D-RAG folder, matching the current index layout
intro: Read this after an index layout change, or when index databases are stranded in an old shared folder. It moves each project index into that project own _D-RAG folder; without --apply it only reports what it would move.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint migrate-dbs [--config <drag-lint.json>] [--apply] move project indexes into each project's _D-RAG folder
help: drag-lint migrate-dbs        [--config <drag-lint.json>] [--apply]   move project indexes into each project's _D-RAG folder
drag-lint --help             (aliases -h / -?). Accepted AFTER A VERB too: `drag-lint lint --help`,
`drag-lint query find-callers -h` and `drag-lint index -?` all print THIS
banner and exit 0. Until 2026-08-28 every one of those FATALed with exit 3.
